league.title: Firm league
league.lead: Nine firms ranked by gross multiple.
league.measure: Gross multiple = (returned + model value of holdings) ÷ invested. Before fees. Rival firms start with the companies they already own.
league.h2h.total: {count, plural, one {# auction lost} other {# auctions lost}}

league.house.0.style: Large industrial components. Buys with discipline and walks away when it gets expensive.
league.house.2.style: Cold chain logistics specialist. Pays fair value and no more.
league.house.3.style: Sector-agnostic. The highest bidder in any auction.
league.house.4.style: Small-cap value buyer. Buys building products cheap.
league.house.5.style: Business services roll-up. Pays up for companies it can add to a platform.
league.house.6.style: Food manufacturing. Takes its time and looks for a long while.
league.house.7.style: Small-cap generalist. Shows up on any small deal.
